title: fix(security)!: under a wall the /packages verbs that publish, discard, roll back, revert, duplicate or adopt catalog items are the platform operator's (ADR-0131 D3)
body:
Part of #15204

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage W3 of #15204, measured in 6117740670 and accepted for build by the seat. This is the walled catalog refusal at the remaining `/packages` write doors. W (#22895) refused catalog writes at `/meta`, the clone door and the data door. W2 (#22935) refused them at `install-local` and at `DELETE /packages/:id`. This PR refuses the seven package verbs that still published, discarded, rolled back, reverted, copied or adopted the operator's catalog items behind `manage_metadata` alone.

## The ruling this executes

ADR-0131 D3: "tenant admins cannot create or edit catalog items; the operator defines the catalog for every tenant (managed packages, Studio)". Under `group` / `isolated`, below the operator rung (and not `isSystem`), each door refuses when the items its verb acts on include a position, a permission set or a capability. That is the placement (a) to (e) of 6117740670.

## Measured first

The harness is the W2 one: a booted `examples/app-crm` stack (`bootStack`, `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`) with two organizations.
- Organization A's owner holds `manage_metadata` inside organization A (rung `TENANT_ADMIN`).
- The operator published a permission set in a writable runtime package (commit c1).
- Organization B's member holds that set.

Isolated and group answered identically:

| Door (A, below the operator) | Answer | B afterwards |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` (the operator's pending draft adds `manage_users`) | 200 | **gains `manage_users`** |
| `POST /packages/:id/rollback {commitId: c1}` | 200 | **loses it** |
| `POST /packages/:id/commits/:c3/revert` (the operator's re-publish) | 200 | **loses it** |
| `POST /packages/:id/duplicate` | 200; the set is copied under the **same name** into A's package, and `GET /meta/permission/:name` then serves A's copy | unchanged |
| `POST /packages/:id/revert` (discard drafts) | 200; the operator's pending catalog draft is gone | unchanged |
| `POST /packages/:id/discard-drafts` (not measured; found by contract review 6121612552) | same population and per-draft step as `revert` | unchanged |
| `POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans` | 200; environment catalog rows, the operator's included, are rebound into A's package | unchanged |

By reading, `commits/:commitId/revert` passes only the commit id to `revertCommit`; the URL's `:id` is never read. 17.7.0 (`4e4e881427`) carries all seven doors, each gated by `requireManageMetadata` alone (`discard-drafts` at `4e4e881427:1792`).

## What changed

- **One helper:** `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` generalises W2's `refuseWalledCatalogPackageDelete`, and the W2 delete now uses it.
  - It asks `walledCatalogWriteVerdict` FIRST. Its answer does not vary across catalog types, so when it admits the caller (under `single`, with no `tenancy` service, for `isSystem`, or for the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung) nothing is read, and the door behaves as before.
  - Only for a refused caller does it read the items the verb acts on, and it refuses `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the posture when they include a catalog type.
- **What each door judges:**
  - `publish-drafts`, `discard-drafts` and `revert`: the package's `sys_metadata` draft rows.
  - `rollback`: the items of every `apply` commit of the target's package at or after the target's instant, a superset of the reverted ones. Read as `rollbackToPackageCommit` reads them: the target row, then `listCommits`.
  - `commits/:commitId/revert`: that commit's own items, whatever package the URL names.
  - `duplicate`: the rows `duplicatePackage` copies (active, organization-less).
  - `adopt-orphans`: the orphans exactly as `reassignOrphanedMetadata` selects them (organization-less rows with a null, empty or `sys_metadata` package).
- **ADR-0087:** the semantic entry `walled-catalog-package-verbs-retired`. The changeset carries FROM → TO per door.
- **Census:** row 55b names the eight `/packages` write doors (the delete included) and the three catalog types; its anchor moves to `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`. The one `isSystem` read moved into the helper, and none was added.
- **Docs:** `api/metadata-api.mdx` (each verb and what it is judged by) and `permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (the verbs that publish, discard, roll back, revert, duplicate or adopt catalog items, `discard-drafts` included).

## Tests

- **Pins:** `wall-package-doors-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, 23 tests.
  - Under each of `isolated` and `group`, these are refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the posture:
    - publish-drafts;
    - revert and discard-drafts (the operator's draft stays);
    - rollback;
    - commit revert, and the same commit under a URL naming A's own package;
    - duplicate (nothing copied);
    - adopt-orphans (the orphan stays unbound).

    Each pin compares B's resolution across its own request only.
  - **Controls:** A runs every door but `adopt-orphans` on its own catalog-free package as before (that verb reads the environment's orphans, and this environment carries the operator's catalog orphan); the operator runs every door, `adopt-orphans` included, on the catalog-carrying one.
  - **`single` control:** the same `manage_metadata` holder runs them all as before.
- **Ablation, one per door:** each refusal was forced to admit (`isSystem` passed to that call site alone), `runtime` rebuilt, and the marker confirmed in `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight`. Exactly that door's pins went red under both postures: publish-drafts 2, discard-drafts 2, revert 2, rollback 2, commit revert 4, duplicate 2 (re-run after the duplicate reader narrowed), adopt-orphans 2. Everything else stayed green, W2's 19 pins included. Each was restored to the `HEAD` blob and rebuilt, and all seven markers are absent from `dist/`.

- **Suites and gates** on this head `f10bbe8e8a` (main `0ede0f8ab3` plus W3):
  - the three wall pin files: 59/59 (W3 23, W2 19, W 17);
  - `check:system-context-census` OK;
  - `runtime`: 359 files / 5,884 passed, 19 skipped;
  - `dispatch-gates --commands`: 110 of 110 exit 0;
  - `check-commit-card-trailers` over the three new commits: clean.
- **Round-1 finding, fixed:** `check:query-options-erasure` refused two `as any` casts on the helpers' engine reads, which now carry typed options.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not decided here (the maintainer's):** whether a walled organization's `manage_metadata` may author or publish the environment's non-catalog metadata through these doors. A package whose drafts, commits or rows carry no catalog item is handled as before.
- `adopt-orphans` under a wall: any environment catalog orphan refuses the whole adoption, since the verb rebinds every orphan at once. The operator adopts them, or a catalog-free environment adopts as before.
